shayari:
Khamoshi bhi bahut kuch keh jaati hai,
Bas samajhne wala koi chahiye.
title: Kuch Baatein Dil Mein Reh Jaati Hain

shayari:
Kabhi waqt kam pad jata hai,
To kabhi raaste lambay lagte hain.
Zindagi ki is daud mein,
Hum khud se hi thoda peeche chhoot jate hain.
Par seekh rahe hain har din,
Safar ka maza lena bhi zaroori hai.
title: Zindagi Ka Safar Aur Hum | Heart Touching Shayari

shayari:
Tujhe bhoolne ki koshish mein,
Har din thoda aur toot jate hain.
Laga tha waqt bhar dega har zakhm,
Par purane panne aaj bhi rulate hain.
Tera zikr jab bhi hota hai kahin,
Hum muskura kar baat badal jaate hain.
title: Tujhe Bhool Na Paye 💔 | Sad Heartbreak Shayari | Emotional Line

shayari:
Tujhe door se dekhna bhi ek sukoon deta hai,
Tera naam sun kar muskuraana acha lagta hai.
Pata hai mujhe ki tu kabhi mera nahi hoga,
Par is ek tarfa pyaar ko nibhana acha lagta hai.
title: Ek Tarfa Pyaar Ka Sukoon | Emotional Hinglish Shayari

shayari:
Tumhari ek jhalak hi kafi hai mera din banane ke liye,
Hum toh door se hi muskura lete hain tumhein dekh kar.
Pata hai hamein ki hum tumhari kahani mein nahi,
Par tum meri har duaa ka sabse khoobsurat hissa ho.
title: Ek Tarfa Pyar Ki Khubsoorat Feeling | Heart Touching Love Shayari #Shorts

shayari:
Humne mohabbat mein kuch nahi maanga,
bas tera saath maanga tha.

Tumne woh bhi waqt ke hawale kar diya,
aur humne use yaad bana kar rakh liya.
title: Bas Tera Saath Maanga Tha 💔 | Love Shayari

shayad kisi mod par mulaqat hogi.
